Callout.Name: Valet - Keys Taken
Callout.Message: Car keys taken from a valet desk.
Callout.Advisory: Two suspects, one seen going through the desk.

Script.Line: The board was open and the desk was empty.
I was looking for my own keys.
There are forty keys on that board. Count them and tell me which one is missing.

Lines.Approach: They took the keys off the board, so they can take any car on that lot.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
